description: 1N4001 1 A, 50 V rectifier diode (our fit to Diotec's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

fit.figure: Forward characteristics (typical values), Tj = 25 °C (read from the PDF's vector drawing, centre of the drawn line), up to about 3 A
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point, the curve's last point always included; IS held under the sheet's 5 µA leakage limit at VRRM; CJO is the sheet's typical 15 pF (at 4 V; a little under the zero-bias value); no breakdown modelled (50 V is never reached in a pedal)
fit.note: The figure starts at 10 mA; below that the fit follows the diode equation, not the sheet
